sobreNosotras.imagenAlt: Estefanía Montalbán Pino and Camila Ogalde Fonck
parrafos: We are Estefanía Montalbán Pino and Camila Ogalde Fonck, lawyers from Universidad Católica del Norte, committed to a close, strategic and rigorous preparation for the degree exam ⚖️

We created Pregunta Estratégica from our own experience, with the purpose of giving you tools, real support and a methodology focused on strengthening your knowledge, oral expression and confidence to face this important challenge 📚
